verses.gurmukhi: ੮ : ਰਾਮ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਤੋਂ ਧੂੜੀ ਦਾ ਉਪਦੇਸ਼
verses.translit_en: 8 : raam cha(n)dhr to(n) dhooRee dhaa upadhesh

en.bdb: From Ramchandr teachings of dust of feet

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਸਰਥੁ ਕਉਸਲਿਆ ਰਲੀਆਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: ra(n)g mahal ra(n)g raag vich dhasarath kausaliaa raleeaale|

en.bdb: In their pleasure palace, Daisarath and Kaus'alya were absorbed in their joys.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਤਾ ਮਤਾਇਨਿ ਆਪ ਵਿਚਿ ਚਾਇ ਚਈਲੇ ਖਰੇ ਸੁਖਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: mataa matain aap vich chai chieele khare sukhaale|

en.bdb: In their exultations they were planning as to what should be the name of their son yet to be born.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਅਸਾੜੈ ਪੁਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਉ ਕਿ ਧਰੀਐ ਬਾਲਕ ਬਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: ghar asaaRai put hoi naau k dhareeaai baalak baale|

en.bdb: They thought that the name should be Ram Chandr because just reciting the name of Ram

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਚੰਦੁ ਨਾਉ ਲੈਂਦਿਆਂ ਤਿੰਨਿ ਹਤਿਆ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: raam cha(n)dh naau lai(n)dhiaa(n) ti(n)n hatiaa te hoi niraale|

en.bdb: They would get rid of three killings (embroy and its parents murder).

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜ ਪਰਵਾਣ ਜਗਿ ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਧਰਮ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: raam raaj paravaan jag sat sa(n)tokh dharam rakhavaale|

en.bdb: The Ram Rai (kingdom of Ram) in which truth, contentement and dharma were protected,

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਣੈ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ਬਸਿਸਟੁ ਬਹਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: maiaa vich udhaas hoi sunai puraan basisaT bahaale|

verses.translit_en: raamain varataiaa silaa taree pag chhuh tatakaale|

en.bdb: Through the Rtimayatt people came to know that the stone (Ahalya) was restored to life by the touch of the feet of Rim.
